description:
The balena CLI is a Command Line Interface for balenaCloud or openBalena.

The balena CLI is a Command Line Interface for balenaCloud or openBalena.
It is a software tool available for Windows, macOS and Linux, used through a command prompt / terminal window.
It can be used interactively or invoked in scripts.
The balena CLI builds on the balena API and the balena SDK, and can also be directly imported in Node.js applications.
The balena CLI is an open-source project on GitHub, and your contribution is also welcome!
Update dependency open to v8

Notable changes
- Fix support for Podman 51fae87
- Fix allowNonzeroExitCode option (#296) 051edca
- Fix the app argument with WSL (#295) 4cf1a6d
- Improve ArchLinux support (#265) b58fb1f
- Add openApp method (#263) 1acc682
- Gracefully handle reused array being passed in (#255) 492445a
- Add newInstance option for macOS (#253) 5e663d6
- Add open.apps.edge (#252) aff3e84
- Revert "Hide PowerShell window on Windows" (#250) 1ee638c
- WSL: Ignore commented mount point lines in wsl.conf (#247) 5b3b01c
- Fix multiple apps support for open.apps (#245) b75ebaa
- Fix getting WSL mount point on Windows (#243) 4ab321b
- Fix chrome app on macOS (#240) 87f3d7a
- Fix the app.argument option (#237) e127ae8
- Hide PowerShell window on Windows (#235) 53faf7f
- Fix a regression in v8.0.0 (#232) 26ee3d2
- Fix Node.js 12 compatibility (#229) 71777b1
- Require Node.js 12 cde5c79
- Removed deprecated url option
- The app option now accepts an object instead of a string/array:
- app: 'firefox'
- app: ['chrome', '--incognito']
- Add open.apps constants, which lets easily open Chrome and Firefox without cross-platform issues
